title: EvoMentor_DE Basiskonzept-Kohaerenzfaden
description: A 'coherence thread' -- an evidence-grounded chain showing how two or more KMK Basiskonzepte connect through a shared evolutionary explanation, anchored to real Lernziele across one or more grade bands. Designed to cross-reference, not duplicate, the other artifacts built this session: basiskonzeptPfad[].relationType reuses conceptbase RFC-0018's frameworkRelation.schema.yaml relationType enum verbatim (so a thread's basiskonzept-level edges are the SAME controlled vocabulary as the pairwise relations in framework-relations/KMK-BASISKONZEPTE-BIOLOGIE-RELATIONS-v1.0.0.yaml, not a parallel one); basiskonzeptPfad[].basiskonzeptTag uses the same 'kmk-basiskonzepte-biologie:bk_...' tag-id format as RFC-0018's subject/object fields and the MEM shadow graph's evomentor:basiskonzeptPrimaer/Sekundaer literals (mem-ontology/lehrplan-th-shadow.ttl); lernzielStationen[].lernzielId is the raw source id (matching basiskonzepte.json's own lernziel_ids_thuringia arrays), from which em-item:thuringia-{id.lower()} (EvoMentor v2 canonical items) and thsh:lz-{gradeband}-{slug} (MEM shadow graph) are both mechanically derivable.

typ.description: vertikal: spans multiple grade bands (spiral-curriculum revisit). horizontal: within one grade band, crosses Basiskonzepte via real prerequisite/enables edges already in the data. vertikal-horizontal: does both.

evolutionaererKern.description: The evolutionary mechanism/idea that is the actual hub tying every station together -- the 'why', not just a list of co-occurring tags.

basiskonzeptPfad.description: Ordered path of Basiskonzept-to-Basiskonzept edges this thread traces. Each edge's relationType is drawn from the identical controlled vocabulary conceptbase RFC-0018 defines (frameworkRelation.schema.yaml) -- deliberately not a new vocabulary.

rolleImFaden.description: What this Basiskonzept contributes at this point in the narrative.

relationTypeZumNaechsten.description: Relation from this station to the NEXT basiskonzeptPfad entry. Omitted on the last entry.

lernzielId.description: Raw source id from data/lernziele_*.json, e.g. 'GY-78-HUM-VD-2'.

basiskonzeptTag.description: Which basiskonzeptPfad station this Lernziel instantiates.

kohaerenzErklaerung.description: The actual narrative explanation connecting every station through evolutionaererKern -- prose a teacher could say in class, not a restatement of the tags.

unterrichtsimpuls.description: A concrete bridging activity/question a teacher could use to make the thread explicit to students.

evidenz.description: How this thread was identified from the real data (co-occurrence analysis, cross-Basiskonzept prerequisite-chain mining, unterthema keyword recurrence, etc.) -- reproducibility, not just assertion.

luecken.description: Known gaps: where the thread's real data anchors currently stop and new content would be needed to complete it.
